verdict.rationale: Column's docs say the API is defined by an OpenAPI spec that is also available as JSON and can be used to generate type-safe client SDKs. An independent probe confirmed docs.column.com/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 and contains an "openapi" key. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration that the spec is complete and works for codegen, and documentation of spec versioning or update cadence.
